name: Song of the Vigil
desc: A long spear that once stood guard over all. Today, it has found a new purpose with children and their games of make-believe.

materials.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

materials.name: The Frost Emperor's Revival
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
The hero who emerged from the snowfields had yet to become the ruler of that frozen realm, but even then, he had already shown a habit of confiding far too much to those around him.
So he was all the more surprised when he received a gift from the fae of snow, who at the time had not yet taken their human form.
As far as he knew, he never told them that he was born from an egg as pale as ice deep within the wing-like mountains, nor did he ever mention the date of his birth.

materials.name: Hollow Root of Life
materials.desc:
A branch dropped by a Leshy before it returned to silence.
With only a few crystals grown upon it, this branch holds little power and gives off a faint glow.

materials.name: Ethereal Glimmershard
materials.desc:
The remains of a Snezhnayan fae left behind after battle.
These shards once coated the creature's body like crystalline scales. Upon falling away, they stripped themselves of all colors, shifting into something akin to the dusty dross of a moth's wings.

materials.name: Mora
materials.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

materials.name: The Frost Emperor's Ceremony
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
The fae of the court didn't understand why a gift meant for the Tsar must be made in such shape. They knew only to lavish their craft upon ornaments bright as jewels.
Only the Tsar seated upon the throne and the fae of snow understood the meaning behind it.
For what mattered was never the ceremony, but the ancient truth it preserved.

materials.desc:
A branch dropped by a Leshy before it returned to silence.
A branch bearing a fair number of crystals. It feels heavy in the hand, and traces of vitality can still be felt within it even after it has broken away from the Leshy's body.

materials.name: Ethereal Crystal
materials.desc:
The remains of a Snezhnayan fae left behind after battle.
A shattered fragment of the crystalline scales that once grew upon the fae's body. Though it is now a mere empty shell, one can still sense the echo of the unique power that once dwelt within.

materials.name: The Frost Emperor's Lament
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
On the night the truth stirred like bitter waves, she prepared this gift for her friend upon the throne—though she herself was no longer the person she used to be.
They both seemed to understand that they might never speak to each other like this again.
For after that night, the path they once walked together diverged—sundered by the weakness of one, and the fury of the other.

materials.name: Coiled Core of Life
materials.desc:
A branch dropped by a Leshy before it returned to silence.
A branch with a fully formed crystal core. It contains vitality that will not easily fade. If buried in the soil, it would likely grow into a new Leshy before long.

materials.name: Ethereal Crystalscale Stone
materials.desc:
The remains of a Snezhnayan fae left behind after battle.
A crystalline scale that once grew upon the fae's body. It is said that fae possessing a greater abundance of these scales command far greater power. Yet, none can say whether this magic truly originates from within their forms — merely channeled outward through the crystal chunks — or if the chunks themselves are the very vessels of their power.

materials.name: The Frost Emperor's Farewell
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
An object that appeared upon the table on the eve of war, though none knew when or how it'd come to be there.
He recognized it for the handiwork of the friend he hadn't seen for many long years.
Only then did he realize, that this was the beginning of every calamity, the bitter fruit of every desire, and the omen of every destruction.

customize.name: Borderland Polearm Billet
customize.desc:
Weapon forging material. Can be used to forge 4-star polearms.

In terms of the "state" of the many weapons that can be crafted from billets, while their potential has long been contained within the original materials, the exact forms these weapons will ultimately take remain unknown to this day...

customize.name: Rainbowdrop Crystal
customize.desc:
A crystal that gives off an iridescent glow. Exceptionally tough and malleable, it has been regarded by Snezhnayan craftspeople as the best forging material since ancient times.
It is believed that when the moon's chariot was shattered, its blood-stained axle-tip fell into the earthly realm beneath the moon, transforming into an iridescent crystal. From that day on, the people of this land no longer worshipped the dead gods. The survivors who knew what the monarchs of the night died for, however, still futilely sing those long-forgotten names.

customize.name: White Iron Chunk
customize.desc: Skilled hands can make this into something brilliant.

customize.name: Diagram: Song of the Vigil
customize.desc: A blueprint recreated by Kuzmichev based on records of old legends. Learn it and you can restore Song of the Vigil (Polearm).

customize.name: Emberwell
customize.desc: A longsword that is entirely gemstone, said to be crafted for the path of righteousness. When unsheathed, it glows with the luster of blue flame.

customize.name: Blade of Atonement
customize.desc: A greatsword passed down by the Luchkin. It is said that only the bravest warrior is qualified to wield it.

customize.name: Echoes of the Heart
customize.desc: A Catalyst said to crystallize voice. Within it lies a sealed oath of loyalty, as well as a heart long since forgotten by mankind.

customize.name: Covenant of Frost and Snow
customize.desc: A longbow crafted to preserve order. Its cold radiance perfectly emanates the ideals of absolute fairness and justice.

desc.text:
"Oh, innocent Manechka, against whom shall you clamor tomorrow?"
"Oh, high-handed Manechka, why do you smile no longer today?"
"Oh, eminent Manechka, did yesterday make you sad?"
"Oh, Manechka, you once garrisoned this land."
The children of the ash-lands continue to sing that ancient song.
They imagine as they sing, and they learn to wield their polearms as the guardian once did.
At first, the young girl was a little lone wolf who knew nothing of defending others.
She would falsely borrow the guiding one's name, concealing her hunger and helplessness under haranguing hubris.
"If you know this spear, then you know whose name Manechka comes in here!"
"A loaf of rye bread with twice the servings of butter and jam! Go on, serve it up, quick!"
She succeeded in this venture many times, until the day she encountered the very person whose name she'd falsely taken up, himself feigning a glare of displeasure.
The girl apologized in a panic, dividing her spoils in two to seek forgiveness, only for the other party to laugh aloud.
"O wolf cub of the snowy plains, enjoy the fruit of your hunt."
"There is no need to fear, for you will receive the care you deserve from now on."
Later, the young girl would follow the guiding one, casting down injustice and upholding the good with her spear in hand,
Sometimes leading a wolf pack that answered her call, defending the ashes with innocent devotion.
Then, the brutal acts of the Burner of Cities threatened to raze this land and destroy its people's homes.
As the final battle neared, and she prepared to leave alongside the guiding one, she turned and warned the people thus:
"Do no evil, and do not wield your power to oppress others. If you do anything that betrays your conscience,"
"And we hear of it, rest assured, you won't walk free when we get back."
The girl who returned alone had to learn how to be a calm alpha wolf, for the sake of the hard-won peace,
And for the sake of the guide's last command. She remembered her oath, and would shoulder the burden of defending the people alone.
"Such a price she paid! A half-loaf of bread could have settled things at the start, but Manechka let herself be won over by Big Brother's care."
"A good trade, that was. This story must be told so that future generations will remember the debt the guide owes."
The years of her vigil passed, until the snow-covered land was no longer so full of scars.
Until the children had grown up, and their children then bore the story with them as they took root in the earth.
"Oh, innocent Manechka, against whom shall you clamor tomorrow?"
"Oh, high-handed Manechka, why do you smile no longer today?"
"Oh, eminent Manechka, did yesterday make you sad?"
"Oh Manechka, the ash-lands will always be your home."
They imagine as they sing, and they learn to wield their polearms as the guardian once did.
The children of the ash-lands continue to sing that ancient song.

value.text: Triggering an Elemental Reaction regenerates <color=#36ffff>4/5/6/7/8</color> Elemental Energy for the equipping character. This effect can trigger once every 9s. On the other hand, triggering a Stellar Glimmer reaction increases their ATK by <color=#36ffff>20%/25%/30%/35%/40%</color> for 12s. The aforementioned effects can trigger even when the character is not on the field.
